title: Bee Sorter Improvement - Complicated Bees Mod
description: A small resourcepack which adds cardinal shortenings to the blockfaces to make it easier to identify.
body:
It's a simple resourcepack, it just retextures the cardinal faces of the [Complicated Bees](https://modrinth.com/mod/complicated-bees) Bee Sorter and it's GUI.

This is designed to make identifying the sides much simpler.
The North, East, South, West, Up and Down faces are changed to be more readable.

Although I have maintained the colours of the original block, I may still tweak some for better visibility should it become an apparent issue.<
